About Me

Connecting my village to the world

Assalam-o-Alaikum! I'm Wasim Khan from Baringan, Tehsil Rustam, District Mardan. I founded Pace Fiber to bring fast, reliable internet to our villages — we now connect homes across Baringan and Shahoro.

I also run Wasim's Sociopolitix, where I post daily Urdu commentary on Pakistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa news.
